text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Summer camp begins today, and in order to conquer the autumn Tenno Sho and Arima Kinen races, it's going to be an intensive one!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Are you ready, Trainer? The types of training available exclusively in the summer are comparable to the number of stars in space!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Time is short, so make sure you plan out an effective training regimen for me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Compared to last year, Agnes Tachyon has turned over a new leaf and is taking training seriously!
